It is south of and adjacent to Grymforge, and home to the Adamantine Forge and serves as a connecting landmass between the former and the latter, and overlooks Ancient Temple.

entries.name: Goblin Celebration

entries.name: Secluded Cove

entries.name: Secret Chamber

entries.name: Shattered Sanctum
entries.description: The Shattered Sanctum is a Location within the Wilderness in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. It is the interior area of the Goblin Camp, and leads to the Defiled Temple and Worg Pens.

entries.name: Tiefling Refugee Celebration
entries.description: The tiefling refugee celebration is a special camp event which occurs after completing either ⁠Defeat the Goblins or ⁠Raid the Emerald Grove, while siding with the tieflings.

entries.name: Underdark
entries.description: The Underdark is a region in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. It is a vast series of caverns and tunnels devoid of sunlight but full of dangerous creatures and even more dangerous mushrooms. It also contains a multitude of alchemical ingredients that are hard to find elsewhere.

entries.name: Underground Passage

entries.name: Whispering Depths
entries.description: The Whispering Depths is a Location within the Blighted Village in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. It is situated below the village.

entries.name: Wilderness

entries.name: Worg Pens
entries.description: The Worg Pens is a Location within the Shattered Sanctum in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. It is a separate sub-area which can be reached only from the Sanctum.

entries.name: Ruined Battlefield
entries.description: A large battlefield spanning half the region, with remnants of a conflict from before the shadow curse.

entries.name: Last Light Inn

entries.name: Reithwin Town

entries.name: Grand Mausoleum
entries.description: The Thorm family mausoleum, resting place of Melodia Thorm and entrance to the Gauntlet of Shar.

entries.name: Moonrise Towers

entries.name: Shadowfell
entries.description: A plane of shadows and domain of Shar.

entries.name: Brain Mapping Puzzle
entries.description: In the southeast section of the Necrotic Lab area of the Mind Flayer Colony, there is a console. Interacting with the console using Illithid powers projects an empty neural map of one of the brains the Mind Flayers have been experimenting on. The neural map is basically a connect the dots puzzle; solving it allows to access the Waking Mind, which can be inserted into The Mind-Archive Interface at X: 699 Y: -117 in order to gain the permanent buff: Githzerai Mind Barrier. Solving the puzzle also grants the inspiration ⁠Brain Blast! for party members with the Sage background. Note for console users: To use the nodes, console users should enter interaction mode (L3; pressing down on the toggle stick) and select "use" on each node.

entries.name: Gauntlet of Shar
entries.description: The Gauntlet of Shar is a Location within the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two of Baldur's Gate 3. It is only accessible through the Grand Mausoleum in the Shadow-Cursed Lands. It is the major dungeon of Act Two, featuring many puzzles and combat encounters, and its completion leads to pivotal developments in multiple questlines. This location also plays a central role in Shadowheart's personal quest ⁠Daughter of Darkness.

entries.name: Tadpoling Centre

It is where captives of the Cult of the Absolute deemed worthy of further 'usage' are kept, tadpoled and sometimes turned into mind flayers. It can be reached (as the rest of the colony) only within Act Two of the game and only after the initial fight with Ketheric Thorm.

entries.name: Mapping of the Heart
entries.description: The Mapping of the Heart is a ritual carried out by the Inquisitor of Shar at the House of Grief. The mapping is performed on whoever sits on the stone bench at X: -272 Y: 9. Only one character per run can undergo the Mapping of the Heart. Shadowheart will have a unique interaction with the Inquisitor on the bench and will not complete a typical mapping. The answers to the mapping affect the battle with the Viconia DeVir by giving her two specialized spells Castigate Heartform and Mapped Terror. The Mapping can be skipped entirely by passing a DC 20 Investigation Check to find a button on the wall that opens the hidden passage to the Cloister of Sombre Embrace, or by initiating combat with at least three of the Sharrans in the above-ground part of House of Grief, at which point the button becomes visible.

entries.name: Avernus
entries.description: Avernus is the first layer of the Nine Hells, in both the setting of Baldur's Gate 3, as well as the Forgotten Realms universe the game sources its setting from.

entries.name: Faerûn
entries.description: Faerûn is a major continent on Toril, and is the place where the vast majority of the events of Baldur's Gate 3 happen. The word Faerûn is a modified version of the name of the homeland of the ancient elves, "Faerie".

entries.name: Nine Hells
entries.description: The Nine Hells are the infernal lower Planes, each ruled by an Archdevil. They are home to Devils and divided into nine cosmological layers. Every layer is its own unique magical ecosystem, warped after the sheer presence of their rulers. The Nine Hells are locked into a never-ending Blood War with the Demons of the Abyss.

entries.name: River Chionthar
entries.description: The River Chionthar is a wide river that runs from Iriaebor to the Sword Coast. The Risen Road runs parallel to the river.

entries.name: Sword Coast
entries.description: The Sword Coast is a region of Faerûn along its northwestern coast. It is where the majority of the events of Baldur's Gate III take place, more specifically along the north bank of the Chionthar river between the cities of Baldur's Gate and Elturel. The dimensions of the Sword Coast are somewhat subjective (both in- and out-of-universe), and overlap with other regional concepts such as "the Western Heartlands" and "the North". The Sword Coast's southern border is generally agreed to be the Cloud Peaks, which separate it from Amn. The northern border is usually given as Waterdeep, but some sources go further up to Neverwinter or Luskan. The eastern (inland) border is the vaguest, with different sources placing it anywhere from the Misty Forest and Wood of Sharp Teeth to the Sunset Mountains and Anauroch desert.

entries.name: Toril
entries.description: Toril is the planet on which Faerûn is situated.

entries.name: Waterdeep
entries.description: The city of Waterdeep is a cosmopolitan city on the Sword Coast in the Forgotten Realms.
